market_note: Stablecoin market cap tops $240B (USDT ~67%, USDC ~27%) as the GENIUS Act's July 18 rulemaking deadline passed without final rules from regulators.

stablecoin_items.headline: GENIUS Act rulemaking deadline missed
stablecoin_items.summary: Six federal agencies missed the July 18 statutory deadline to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules; issuers still await final capital and charter requirements.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether launches USAT for US compliance
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether is rolling out USAT, a new US-domiciled stablecoin built for GENIUS Act compliance, while pursuing a foreign-issuer path for USDT itself.

stablecoin_items.headline: Stablecoin market cap passes $240B
stablecoin_items.summary: Outstanding stablecoin supply now exceeds $240 billion, with Tether's USDT holding roughly 67% share and Circle's USDC around 27%.

stablecoin_items.headline: Fidelity and Samsung push mainstream adoption
stablecoin_items.summary: Fidelity Digital Assets announced its first stablecoin, FIDD, on Ethereum, while Samsung said it will add native stablecoin support to Samsung Wallet.

hack_items.headline: AFX bridge exploit drains $24M on Arbitrum
hack_items.summary: Attackers compromised five validator keys to hit quorum on an AFX-powered bridge, draining $24.15M in USDC and converting it to ETH (July 22).

hack_items.headline: Triple-A hot wallets drained of $9.7M
hack_items.summary: Crypto payments firm Triple-A had hot wallets across TRON, Ethereum, TON and Solana drained of roughly $9.7M in stablecoins and liquid assets (July 24-25).

hack_items.headline: Lien Finance loses $542K in bond-pricing exploit
hack_items.summary: Attackers manipulated bond pricing in Lien Finance's OTC pools on Ethereum to drain USDC liquidity on July 24.

hack_items.headline: "Hackers' Day" totals $35.5M across 3 exploits
hack_items.summary: On July 23, three separate DeFi exploits totaled $35.55M in losses, pushing the month's cumulative hack losses toward $100M.
